status: INERT; NOT EXECUTED ON THE REAL SOURCE BY THE AUTHOR; ROOT REVIEW AND RUN REQUIRED

layouts.MRT_INFILE_HEADER: used only if the in-file header lines exactly match (labels, bytes, formats, units)
layouts.CDS_TABLE1_README: used only if the ReadMe pin matches and each of the seven table1.dat description lines (bytes, format, unit, label, documented range) occurs exactly once in the table1.dat section
layouts.DECLARED: only via --declared-layout with matching sha256, non-empty declared_by and evidence; fields Galaxy, Type, D, e_D, f_D, Inc, e_Inc; formats A/I/Fw.d with width = span; no overlap; no byte beyond 41

checks_per_field: right-justified ASCII digits only; Fw.d exactly d decimals; no sign, exponent, nan/inf, internal or trailing blank
domain: D finite >0; e_D >=0; f_D in 1..5; 0<=Inc<=90; e_Inc >=0; Type 0..11
CDS documented column range when the CDS layout is evaluated
checks_per_row: target found exactly once (aliases as V001)
row reaches the layout's last byte

statuses.PASS_DOCUMENTED_LAYOUT: exactly one documented layout passes, no declaration
statuses.PASS_DECLARED_LAYOUT: declared layout passes and no documented layout passes
statuses.FAILED_DECLARATION_CONFLICT: declared and a documented layout both pass
statuses.FAILED (code): pin, usage, output-exists, declaration or unexpected error; no output file

emission: Values (D, e_D, f_D with Note-2 meaning, Inc, e_Inc, source line) only under PASS_*. FAILED outputs carry masks and booleans only. Type is validated, not emitted.
exposure: the whole file is read into memory, hashed and split into byte lines; bytes 1-11 of each post-header row are compared with target names; for target rows only bytes 1-41 are kept, decoded and interpreted; bytes beyond 41 are never decoded, parsed, compared, measured or emitted.
semantics: Catalogue values as published; e_D, e_Inc catalogue mean errors, not covariance; Inc = mean outer-HI-disk value (CDS Note 3). No geometry adopted by running the extractor.
